hooks.command: command -v basemind >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; rel=$(realpath --relative-to="$PWD" "$f" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$rel" ] && exit 0; basemind rescan "$rel" -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
command -v basemind >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; basemind scan -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
hooks.statusMessage: basemind: catching up on out-of-band changes
